subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 1: revises Term 2 sounds; 'ck' (sick, pack, sock, kick); rhyming words (pack/sack)

show.line: c and k together say one sound at the end. Sock, kick, pack!

rounds.prompt: Listen. s, i, ck. What word is it?
Does it end like sock? Sort the pictures.

hints: c and k together make one sound at the end.
Listen to the end of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that rhymes with sock.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sack does not rhyme with sock. Rock rhymes with sock.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Sock, rock. Same at the end!

parent_line: Can read words that end in ck, like sock, kick and pack.
